objective.summary: Play an E Dorian hybrid-picking line across strings 2–5 with syncopated eighth-note placement at 90 BPM for 10 minutes of focused practice.
Complete eight clean two-string alternate-picking cycles at 100 BPM.
Perform five ascending/descending five-string major-triad arpeggio cycles at 80 BPM.
Perform a four-bar blues phrase using controlled bends followed by vibrato.
Locate and play at least six C-major triad inversions within the first 12 frets.
Map the G major scale on string 2 from open position through fret 12.
Identify ten perfect-fifth locations from prompted roots within the first 12 frets.
Connect minor-triad arpeggio tones through frets 5–12 using non-adjacent strings.
Construct ten prompted major or minor triads within three minutes.
Voice-lead a D I–IV–V progression while keeping each top-voice move within two semitones.
Identify or construct eight valid secondary-dominant resolutions.
Create an eight-bar progression in C using at least two borrowed chords.
Maintain a syncopated eighth-note pattern at 85 BPM for 90 seconds.
Perform a repeating 7/8 phrase at 110 BPM for 16 measures.
Maintain a 3:2 polyrhythmic relationship for eight complete cycles.
Execute four clean metric-modulation transitions and return to the original pulse.
Identify at least nine of twelve melodic interval prompts.
Identify eight of ten scale-degree prompts relative to a supplied tonic.
Transcribe a four-bar single-note phrase by ear.
Reproduce or notate six of eight short rhythmic prompts.
Create one four-note motif and develop it into at least three distinct variations.
Perform the same short phrase three times with clearly contrasting articulation and dynamics.
Improvise for five minutes using no more than three pitch classes.
Compose or improvise an eight-bar two-voice guitar sketch with independently moving lines.
